jobs.description:
As an operator, you play an important role in the production process of metal components. You work with modern machines and ensure that each piece is bent and cut according to the correct specifications. Quality and precision are central to your job.

Looking for a full-time welding role in automotive parts manufacturing? This opportunity in Zwevegem starts as an interim assignment with the option of permanent employment. You’ll work with tube products and a range of materials.

Forum Jobs connects talent and companies through a personal approach and broad sector knowledge. As a full-service HR partner, it supports both candidates and employers, bringing a human touch to the recruitment process and helping people find opportunities that fit.

jobs.occupation: Technician in day shift - English is allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a hands-on technician who's already living in Belgium? Do you have solid knowledge of electricity or electromechanics? And are you looking for a stable job in maintenance work with lots of variety? Then this might be the job for you!

For a growing transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for a multi-skilled maintenance technician with a strong background in electrical maintenance or electromechanics to help maintain the buildings, warehouse, technical installations, and outdoor areas of the company. And the best part: Dutch isn't required, so you can also apply if you speak English very well!

Your role

As technician, you play a key role in ensuring the reliability, safety, and operational performance of the infrastructure. You perform both the preventive and corrective maintenance of all the facilities, ensuring the logistical operations keep running safely and efficiently. Electricity is at the heart of the job, but you're also responsible for a wide range of general building maintenance.

Your key duties:

• Perform various kinds of repairs, replacements and maintenance works to the infrastructure of the company
• Carry out preventive technical controls on the various installations
• Keep up the company grounds and outdoor facilities
• Help perform maintenance and repairs to the company vehicles
• Supervise external contractors and service providers
You'll sometimes need to go into the freezer warehouse, of course with the necessary thermal clothing.

Is this you?

• Education and/or experience in electrical maintenance, electromechanics or another relevent technical field
• Able to read electrical diagrams and schematics
• Own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
• Very good knowledge of English, both spoken and written
• Already living in Belgium, preferably in the area of Oostkamp or Bruges
Then please don't hesitate to apply, because this job could be yours!

Any other technical skills are a big plus but not obligated, e.g. mechanics, plumbing, HVAC... The company can teach you these on the job.

Responsibilities

• Translate functional requirements into detailed technical designs and program structures.
• Develop and maintain backend software using mainframe technologies and modern development tools.
• Create and execute comprehensive test cases and perform technical integration testing.
• Conduct self and peer code reviews to maintain high quality and performance standards.
• Analyze and resolve incidents and defects to ensure system reliability.
• Participate in a standby rotation to ensure continuous service availability.

Requirements

• 5+ years of experience in backend development within a mainframe environment.
• You have solid technical expertise in COBOL, PL/1, EGL, and DB2.
• You bring experience with development and versioning tools such as IDz workbench, Changeman, and GitHub.
• You possess the ability to translate business needs into functional and technical specifications.
• You're experienced in working with Agile methodologies in complex environments.
• You are proactive, analytical, and capable of working independently while collaborating with diverse stakeholders.
• You are fluent in Dutch and English.
Nice to Haves

• Experience in financial markets and investment banking.

jobs.occupation: Accounting and Reporting Manager in Brussels
jobs.description:
This newly created position combines technical accounting expertise, business partnering and people management, offering the opportunity to build and develop a function with significant visibility across the organization.You will work closely with a variety of stakeholders while ensuring accurate reporting, financial transparency and high-quality service delivery.

Jobomschrijving

In this role, you will oversee accounting and reporting activities for centrally managed costs and third-party managed assets while acting as a trusted finance partner to key stakeholders.

• Partner with central functions such as IT, Legal and other support teams on financial performance and cost management.
• Own the accounting, reporting and control of centrally managed expenditures.
• Manage the reporting and relationship with third-party property owners, ensuring accurate information and timely responses to inquiries.
• Review monthly financial results, analyse variances and provide clear financial insights.
• Coordinate month-end closing activities, reconciliations and intercompany recharges.
• Drive process improvements, strengthen controls and support systems-related initiatives.
• Lead, coach and develop a small team, fostering collaboration and high performance.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or equivalent experience.
• Solid accounting background with at least 7 years of experience in accounting and financial reporting.
• Fluent in English with excellent communication skills - French and Dutch
• Previous experience managing and developing team members, with a genuine interest in people leadership.
• Strong business partnering mindset and the ability to build effective relationships with both finance and non-finance stakeholders.
• Experience working in an international, multi-entity or shared services environment is a plus.
• Strong knowledge of SAP; experience with ERP implementations or system improvements is highly valued.
